ops.body:
Gate results at ship (2026-07-19):
- Swift: 12/12 (xcodegen + xcodebuild test, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO — the exact ci.yml helper-test commands), goldens loading from tests/fixtures/.
- Python: full suite green on the Track K surface; 3 failures all in untouched files (1 pre-existing dead-shebang env test, 2 live-codex integration tests killed by the org codex quota exhaustion — resets Jul 25).
- Review: 5 correctness dimensions + a security lane; 2 codex(sol) lanes completed before quota death, remainder re-run on opus xhigh with a fable security lane; every major/critical finding adversarially verified by an independent opus xhigh re-reviewer.

Confirmed + FIXED in the ship commit:
1. release-app.yml changed-paths diff base matched prerelease tags → an rc's app changes were silently skipped in the following stable release + cask. Fixed in homebrew-tap b6c1154 (--exclude '*-*'), v1 advanced; proven by git repro.
2. DaemonKit floated (from: 0.1.0 = upToNextMajor, no committed Package.resolved) → pinned exactVersion 0.1.0 in helper/project.yml.
3. opened_at:null / url:"None" in status.json poisoned the entire widget decode (Swift OpenPR.openedAt non-optional) → transition() now stamps pr_opened_at on every pr_open entry; writer emits "" for a missing url and falls back to updated_at for legacy NULL. Regression tests added both sides.
4. client.notify() raised AttributeError on a valid-JSON non-dict reply (breaking never-raises) → typed malformed-reply outcome; also oversized (>64KiB) requests now drop early instead of a doomed launch+poll loop. Tests added.
Plus: helper refusals (ok:false) are now logged in notify._send; SnapshotRefresher watchdog escalates SIGTERM→SIGKILL after 10s; ci.yml gains helper-test (Swift suite never ran in CI) and three pre-existing non-enforcing `! cmd` smoke assertions now enforce.

Refuted: "goldens untracked, commit could omit them" — git-index semantics; jj @ carries both fixtures (verified via jj status).

Accepted WITHOUT fix (rationale):
- Unknown-op golden test bypasses HelperHandler: the handler needs UserNotifications, which a hostless test bundle can't carry — routing coverage would need a host app target (roadmap).
- maybe_notify_failures double-fire race: benign — identical content → identical notification identifier → macOS replaces, never stacks.
- notify_transition runs sync inline (karp said asyncio.to_thread): transition() is a sync method on sync CLI + async sync.py paths; bounded ~5s worst case, benign at actual call sites. Documented deviation.
- Fractional-timestamp + slash/unicode encode coverage: ADDED as Swift tests (no longer gaps).

Release prerequisites still open: two provisioning profiles ("Captain Hook Helper App"/"Captain Hook Helper Widget") must exist in the Apple dev account before the first tagged release; that release proves the cask PUBLISH path (session task #17). Docs pass items: ccn note 7046fe1. Wire contract: ccn doc 66026ba.

Update 2026-07-19 (pre-release prep, release deferred to end of session):
- Cask token renamed `capt-hook-helper` → `captain-hook` in 045650d6 (template now .github/cask/captain-hook.rb.tmpl, release asset basename captain-hook, helper CLI CASK fully qualified yasyf/tap/captain-hook). Any docs/tooling use the new token; `capt-hook` stays reserved for a future CLI formula. See notes 25f1c19 (v10.3.0 version claim) and c533e16 (fleet naming rule).
- All six release secrets pushed to yasyf/captain-hook from 1Password (verified via gh secret list).
- CHANGELOG Unreleased stamped as 10.3.0 in the same commit; the v10.3.0 tag is the release trigger, still pending.
- Portal work (2 App IDs + the 2 profiles) still pending: blocked on cookiesync cold-key auth from headless agent contexts (ioreg SIGKILLed on the biometric path; peer route to yasyf-home down). Unblock at release time: warm the key from a real GUI terminal (`cookiesync auth --browser arc --ttl 30m`), then the browser lane seeds on the warm path.
RELEASE COMPLETE (2026-07-19): both App IDs + Developer ID profiles created via the ASC API (admin key; runbook aabb893 — the browser/cookiesync path is dead for background agents, cookie-sync investigation 26d39fe). v10.4.0's failed helper leg re-run to green: app signed/notarized/stapled, Casks/captain-hook.rb published to homebrew-tap main (811ec3b) — the cask PUBLISH path is proven (session task #17 closed). Live verify: cask install clean, spctl 'Notarized Developer ID' accepted, no quarantine, helper v10.4.0 ping ok, notify round-trip lane=socket ok, status.json fresh. The helper's release notes moved from the phantom 10.3.0 section into 10.4.0 (no v10.3.0 tag exists).
